description: SPEC-0124: score whether a GLB / glTF is commerce-ready for AR Quick Look + web. Composes ACG-2.0 conformance with AR-parity (lossy materials like KHR_materials_transmission, structural USDZ risks, geometry) into ONE verdict — ready | warnings | not-ready — plus explicit must-fix blockers and review warnings. Read-only; does not modify the input. Use this to gate AI-generated 3D output before publishing.

input_path.description: Absolute or sandbox-relative path to the .glb / .gltf file. Must be inside the sandbox root.

target.description: Conformance target. Default "apple-ar" (readiness is an AR-commerce question).

name: commerce_readiness
title: Commerce-readiness scorecard
